description: The plot illustrates the progression of BLEU score over training epochs for three distinct data subsets: “Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data.” The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” spans from 0.0 to approximately 3.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines and tick labels every 0.05. The “Regular members” line (blue, solid) begins near 0.03 at epoch 0.0, rises gradually to about 0.10 by epoch 1.0, and continues increasing to approximately 0.19 by epoch 3.0. The “Members with near-duplicates” line (orange, solid) starts near 0.04, climbs steeply to 0.15 by epoch 0.5, then surges to 0.30 by epoch 1.0, and continues rising to about 0.36 by epoch 3.0. The “Held-out data” line (green, solid) begins near 0.03, increases slowly to 0.08 by epoch 1.0, and reaches approximately 0.15 by epoch 3.0, showing a consistently lower performance compared to the other two lines throughout the training process.
